question: Does their model suffer exhibit performance drops when incorporating word importance?
title: Towards Understanding Neural Machine Translation with Word Importance
answer_rationale: The document states that the gradient-based method (Attribution) outperforms the supervised erasure method (Erasure) when perturbing 2 or more words, and that the authors' approach does not require external resources and is fully unsupervised. This implies that incorporating word importance via their method does not lead to performance drops.
